name: namespace_grant
description: Grants access permissions (READER, WRITER, ADMIN) for a memory namespace to another account TSID. Requires the caller to have ADMIN or OWNER role on the namespace.

slug.description: The namespace slug or TSID identifier to grant access on.

granteeAccountId.description: The TSID identifier of the account being granted access.

role.description: Permission role level: READER (read-only), WRITER (read-write), ADMIN (full admin).

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp when this grant automatically expires.
